title: Sheet-pan chicken fajitas

items: 1½ lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into ½-inch strips
3 bell peppers (any color), sliced ¼ inch thick
1 large yellow onion, sliced ¼ inch thick
8 small flour tortillas (or 3 cups cooked rice)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper third. Line the sheet pan with parchment.
In the large bowl, toss the chicken, peppers and onion with the oil, spices and salt until evenly coated.
Spread everything in a single layer. Use 2 pans if it's crowded, or the vegetables will steam instead of brown.
Roast 20–25 min, stirring once halfway, until the vegetables are charred at the edges and the thickest strip of chicken reads 165°F.
For the last 10 min of roasting, wrap the tortillas in foil and warm them on a lower rack.
Squeeze the lime over the pan and toss. Serve in the warm tortillas or over rice with sour cream and avocado.
tips: For more char, broil the pan for the last 2 min, watching closely.
Chicken breast works too. Check it at 18 min, since it dries out faster.
Cut the chicken and vegetables to the same thickness so they finish at the same time.
storage: Fridge up to 4 days in a sealed container. Reheat in a skillet over medium heat or in the microwave until the chicken is hot (165°F).
